sql: INSERT INTO ingest_runs (root, status, trigger) VALUES (%s, 'running', %s) RETURNING run_id

UPDATE ingest_runs SET finished_at = now(), duration_ms = %(duration_ms)s, total = %(total)s, added = %(added)s, skipped_duplicate = %(skipped_duplicate)s, skipped_unchanged = %(skipped_unchanged)s, needs_ocr = %(needs_ocr)s, empty = %(empty)s, failed = %(failed)s, status = %(status)s, error = %(error)s WHERE run_id = %(run_id)s
